question: In a certain code language, ‘GOAT’ is coded as ‘112’, and ‘LEAF’ is coded as ‘74’. How will ‘PRIDE’ be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee18a7e6c9c120a9ee8d4f7b736bb3eb8644f0023025f54b58cf76c364745566.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'GOAT’ is coded as ‘112’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eddad18670d5892fb6176824b79905a1dd3db526c7619356041dfbb175103acf.png] 

And 

‘LEAF’ is coded as ‘74’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc06cf642416d1b81f03bc72b8c09487d7af406df35441164dbcb20bf8ace932.png] 

Similarly

**'PRIDE' → ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9e18db43a63d4cf62e9a250a244f269f46df0b7adf3129c1171e803f8de6ce3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "104".**
